performance.verdict: ROAS floor holding but 3-day purchase collapse demands creative action now.

findings.text: 3-day ROAS signal is broken: Sep 11–13 shows 3 purchases / $273.80 revenue on $153.03 spend vs Sep 8–10's 6 purchases / $950.98 on $159.24 — a confirmed mid-funnel stall.
SOW: Funnel test + UTM live milestone (Aug 31) is overdue; /halal-subscribe conversion test result still unconfirmed, blocking subscribe-page web work.
SOW: Pre-launch gate (Aug 31) and Platform ownership audit (Aug 31) both overdue with no completion event; Aug 14 live-cooking event content also unconfirmed.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 on Sep 12–13 (prior 7-day avg ~22/day); organic floor that supported paid conversions is gone — likely a posting/profile gap, not a demand drop.
IG reach down 17.8% week-over-week (7d avg ~672 vs prior ~818); flat spend with falling reach and zero purchases Sep 12 suggests creative fatigue on BWS - Sales - Muslims ($840.44 of 28-day spend).

suggestions.text: Inject 2 new real-footage product creatives into BWS - Sales - Muslims to counter fatigue; do not raise budget until new creative shows 3-day purchase recovery.
suggestions.monday_update: The BWS - Sales - Muslims campaign ($840.44 of 28-day spend, 57% of total) shows confirmed purchase collapse Sep 11–13 (3 purchases / $273.80 revenue) alongside a 17.8% IG reach decline — a clear fatigue signal. Action: pull 2 new real-facility or product creatives from the Haney July 21 Drive footage and launch into this campaign without a budget raise. Success check: 3-day purchase count returns to ≥5 and revenue to ≥$450 by Sep 20. If not recovering by Sep 20, escalate budget freeze and broaden audience test.

suggestions.text: Restore GBP posting cadence immediately; 2 consecutive zero-action days (Sep 12–13) are cutting organic support that historically co-occurs with paid purchase days.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 on both Sep 12 and Sep 13, down from a prior 7-day average of ~22 actions/day — a 57.82% weekly decline flagged in triage. Organic GBP engagement has historically aligned with paid purchase days for this client. Action: resume daily GBP posts and verify the profile is not suspended or suppressed. Success check: GBP actions return to ≥15/day within 3 days (by Sep 17). Escalate to Nacer (Ops) if profile access is the blocker.
